messages:
Maya: Quick ping — I opened a small PR that tags console trace spans with `cost_bucket` so we can roll up token-cost telemetry for dashboard charts. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6423 :eyes:
Kevin: Taking a peek now. Is this additive only? any schema changes to the stored span tags?
Maya: Additive only — just adds `cost_bucket` string to span attributes. No DB schema; it's emitted to our tracing backend as a tag.
Aaron: I can review later today, heads up I have a couple of higher-priority items in my queue. If it's tiny might be faster for someone else to do a pass.
Olivia: I can do a quick pass now. If CI is green I can approve.
Tim: CI shows lint failures on the PR still — looks like one formatting issue in `console_trace.py` around an f-string.
Maya: Thanks — pushing a tiny fix now.
DeployBot: CI / checks — 3 failed, 2 passed. See details: https://ci.redwood/6423
Maya: Pushed fix commit `fix(trace): format f-string` — should address lint. Also added a short unit test for the tag presence.
Olivia: Nice. Quick request: can you use `cost_bucket` values like `low|medium|high` instead of freeform numbers? makes aggregation simpler.
Maya: Yep, switched to enum strings in latest commit. Also added a short docstring in the middleware.
Kevin: Small naming nit: prefer `telemetry.cost_bucket` as the tag key (namespacing). otherwise LGTM.
Samira: Also: when we roll this out, can we make the collector fallback to `unknown` if tag missing, to avoid metrics gaps? We should mention that in the rollout notes.
Maya: Good call — fallback added. I'll add a line to the rollout checklist in the PR description.
Aaron: I did a quick diff — tests look fine. One comment on the unit test: can we assert the tag value for a sampled trace as well? Otherwise :+1: from me.
Maya: Added sampled-trace assertion.
Olivia: Re-running CI now. :pray:
DeployBot: CI / checks — all passed.
Olivia: Approved and left a short note about the namespacing. :white_check_mark:
Kevin: Approved after the key rename change.
Samira: Added rollout note in the PR description about collector fallback and dashboard update.
Maya: Thanks everyone — merging now and will kick off a canary deploy with monitoring on the new `telemetry.cost_bucket` metric. :shipit:
Tim: Can you paste the dashboard query you'll use for the canary so I can watch infra costs?
Maya: Will do in a follow-up comment on the PR with the exact query and alerts.
Olivia: Great, thanks all.
Maya: (reacted with :tada:)
